completeSelectedRecord.proposedProcedure:
# Sequester — NEW RIC5-SE-01 through RIC5-SE-04

Action;one actual currently willing existing creature within120feet;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP. The creature must actually communicate informed current agreement to the chosen wake schedule and loss of agency; inability to express that consent is not manufactured from an old alliance or a corpse. No hostile/no-save prison or object/corpse preservation mode is added. Active Undead/Construct can qualify when their actual source provides agency and consent. Required range, perception and line of effect apply.

## Admission and useful suspension
NEW this replaces the historical Instantaneous placeholder with a continuing, nonconcentration magical application. The caster and recipient choose a finite future absolute wake deadline at commitment; no universal numerical maximum is added to a source that prints none, but a missing, infinite or unknowable deadline is invalid. Agreeing to a very long finite deadline grants no infinite resources, inaccessible setting knowledge or safe campaign skip. At resolution admit the actual loss-of-agency component through the same caster-target-encounter whole-Action-denial gate. Willingness alone does not bypass that gate or an actual Incapacitated/suspension immunity. If the suspension cannot genuinely establish, no separate free invisibility remainder establishes from that paid attempt; no guard is consumed without genuine admission.

On admission the same body becomes suspended: actual Incapacitated, Speed0, no voluntary speech, Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions or new orders. End its applicable existing concentration normally. Do not additionally assign Unconscious, automatic critical hits, Prone, death or Petrified merely by analogy. The body's existing posture, anatomy, HP, Wounds, gear, restraints, contact, collision and support remain real. Invisibility conceals its actual body and the real equipment worn/carried at admission while continuously in custody; dropped pieces become visible and later-picked-up cargo is not retroactively concealed. Ordinary sound/position knowledge does not become sight. True Seeing's accepted actual benefits see this Invisible body through darkness, not through real fog or walls. No unrestricted nondetection is granted.

## Exact clock matrix
Pause and store remaining time, without resetting, only intrinsic physical aging, breathing consumption, hunger/thirst/metabolic accumulation, and expressly biological disease/incubation progression. An explicit source imposing magical damage, saves, conditions or deadlines is NOT reclassified as biology by its name. No new poison/disease cure is created. Biological counters not represented in actual content remain explicit content operands rather than invented ages/rates.

The world clock, Sequester's wake deadline, every attached spell's duration, scheduled saves/damage/healing, explicit independent class/body lifetime, actual regular/virtual turn markers, recharge and rule-based beneficial-rest eligibility clocks CONTINUE. In particular poison/curse spell packets, Chill Touch's no-HP-gain deadline, existing Stable recovery deadline, real death-save opportunities and source-qualified passive regeneration remain governed by their own actual sources; this spell gives no blanket exemption or an invented pending-event bank. Sequestered time is not sleep, labor, study, a short rest or a beneficial long rest and earns no rest completion/RP recovery or skill progress. A rest interrupted by admission must satisfy its own restart rules later; do not count the same frozen interval as rest in another tracker. No off-screen free Actions or passive-resource duplicates arise. Explicit biological pause never doubles a source-owned spell deadline.

## Wake, rescue and component-specific suppression
A declared optional wake trigger is one bounded conjunction of at most three directly visible/audible conditions in the creature's actual local30-foot neighborhood, evaluated from that body's position with ordinary line of sight/hearing and physical occlusion. It does not use the suspended creature's voluntary senses or True Seeing; the magical trigger observes only ordinary local sensory input. No secret identity, alignment, thought, remote fact, true-password authentication or invisible entity lookup. Fix the predicates at casting; preserve the finite fallback deadline even with a trigger. Missed observations under actual suppression are not queued; a still-present state can be observed only while this application still exists.

The original caster can end this application with an actual Action while perceiving the same body within120feet and line of effect. Any actual helper can use one Action in real touching reach to wake this application, without needing the invisible body to be seen when its actual location/contact is established. Neither grants a remote free rescue or a new Action. The suspended recipient cannot independently act or dismiss while Incapacitated; the mandatory finite deadline and external rescues are explicit protections against an undefined permanent trap.

Positive post-defense/pre-temporary-HP damage wakes after the actual packet and immediate life/concentration consequences; absorbed temporary HP still counts, zero damage after defenses does not. No retroactive crit or damage modifier is created by waking. Actual death or a transition to zero HP from a separate nondamage cause ends the application; ordinary life rules then continue. An independently due Stable recovery or genuine passive HP gain is not a free Sequester heal and does not itself wake a still-live body unless a stated wake condition actually occurs. Moving/carrying/contact/Falling without damage does not automatically wake, and suspension supplies no Hover, support, damage immunity or transport permission.

Actual suppression of the SUSPENSION expression permanently ends this application and wakes it; it does not refreeze on leaving the field. Full source suppression likewise ends both expressions. A genuinely invisibility-only suppression leaves suspension operative and can allow invisibility to resume within the original deadline. These are NEW Sequester-only lifecycle choices, not general antimagic rules. When a real suppressor prevents admission itself, no dormant queued application is created. Dispel, deadline, successful rescue and other stated endings remove only this source's Incapacitated/Speed0/invisibility; independent conditions remain. Resume paused biological counters with their stored remainder at the real ending time, never a reset or catch-up. No new turn, Reaction refresh, duplicate due save or refunded hard-control history follows.

completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and acquisition
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the complete native classAccess row, actual acquired repertoire/preparation and actual provider. All five identities are rank7/base17RP, Action,120feet,V/S/F; do not replace these with foreign spell rules. Simulacrum is one identity with both native placements: Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard use Illusion, Cleric/Mage use Universal. The other four use their actual Universal rows. Bard/Mirrorsage minimum19 is rank eligibility, not proof of an actual level19 repertoire addition. A positive class19 fixture needs a real acquisition provider; the actual hybrid addition can instead occur at20. None of the five grants an RP pool or a class by being named in a book. Caster class-level scaling, spell attack, DC, discounts, automatic features and owned ledgers are actual-source inputs. The Wizard13 teaching build below uses PB5/INT+4, DC17 and attack+9 outside its chosen Illusion school; School Mastery makes Illusion DC19/attack+11, not DC18. First distinct prepared matrix grants zero BASE strain, not a free casting, and never extends to Cast Echo's temporarily authorized child. No rank9 payload is declared operative by its name alone. All native source objects, old null flags, original decisions and prior reports remain historical bytes; this proposal adds a selected layer, not an index or runtime promotion.

completeSharedRules.title: Paid casting, cadence and ordinary Ready
completeSharedRules.wording: Validate observable acquisition, components, action opportunity, actual targets/range/path and quoted costs before commitment; unknown eligibility is not a free hidden-state diagnostic. Pay the actual Action/RP/other costs and book real Dissonance/history before interruption. A countered, saved-against, missed or late-prevented cast refunds nothing. Rank costs0..9 are0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26. Ordinary base strain is0/1/2 for rank0/1..5/6..9, plus actual Refrain; actual source exceptions remain. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); surcharge applies to the actual precommit D at Limit,Limit+3,Limit+6. No generic overcast, resource conversion, upcast or auto scaling is added. Use one real concentration ledger: beginning another concentration obligation ends the incompatible old one at commitment, even if countered. Ordinary Ready pays and casts at preparation with its one counter window, holds concentration, ends no later than next own regular START, completes the perceived trigger first, then spends the actual Reaction to release with current targets/geometry. No second ordinary casting/payment/counter/history occurs. Only Cast Echo's expressly new child-commit and Reaction-checkpoint clauses below are exceptions. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains a separate feat-only preparation-allowance policy; it is not a charge or permission for these five ordinary spells. The existing class configuration loses1 Dissonance on an actual regular turn without a spell or magical class ability; Refrain does not reset on idle turns. Continuous actual long-cast work is casting activity, not an idle turn. Do not report frozen positive Dissonance through a long sequence of genuinely idle regular turns.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual bodies, rolls and consequences
completeSharedRules.wording: Targets and placed bodies retain actual whole-body geometry, supports, plane/environment, custody, weight and Load. No point through opaque total cover supplies perception or line of effect. A teleport, absent body or size alteration needs its actual source permission; visual images do not become creatures. Attacks use actual AC and natural1/20 attack rules. Saves are total versus DC without natural-die task shifts. Ability-check counter/examination uses the actual task degrees/natural shifts followed by its specified binary collapse. Fresh payload RNG is not a donor's stored roll or a new Fate presentation. Damage follows the source's real save/type defenses, flat-reduction rules, buffers, normal HP, Wounds, life and concentration processing. Damage roots retain the actual dealer and source-specific creation-time Null state; Cast Echo creates a new child, not the donor's root. A finite creature's explicit NullDisabled exception cannot be generalized to living targets or different summons. Zero HP is not automatically actual death. Keep support/Falling and existing injuries, Wounds and independent conditions through invisibility, masking, suspension and copying. A paid effect does not repair unknown content or invent a monster CR or opposed-check modifier.

completeSharedRules.title: Clock, suppression and removal
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual registered regular/virtual markers and absolute deadlines; extra turns do not refresh round allowances or regular-start recharge, and no overdue event is replayed by initiative changes. Incapacitated ends applicable concentration. Suppression is expression-specific and normally does not stop source clocks; dispel/removal is not the same event. Greater Dispel and Lesser Antimagic use their complete actual accepted ranks, areas, paths, timing and persistence, not a generic delete-all rule. The four specifically authored persistent applications below state their own local behavior: Meta Surge stops new waivers while suppressed; Erase removes only the affected protection/memory expression temporarily; Sequester's suspension suppression wakes permanently; Simulacrum full suppression preserves one absent body rather than recreating it. This does not rewrite the differing Companion05 or Illusion13 lifecycles. Existing completed damage/healing/work/memory edits are not rolled back. Due expiry is processed before a new simultaneous voluntary commitment. Source-owned tokens and consumed histories survive resumption, recast and serialization.

completeSharedRules.title: No hidden fact, identity or resource substitution
completeSharedRules.wording: A source's private event, memory or profile record is not a public oracle. No player/controller receives hidden names, HP, allegiance, memories, source IDs or failure-reason diagnostics merely from a paid attempt. A copied memory is no truer than the original accessible belief, and a copied body is not the original entity, its owner, soul, citizen identity or credential. Source-created replica props and derivative bodies supply no loot, XP, corpse fuel, crafting material, soul, resource-on-kill or duplicated historical entitlement. Their expressly paid intrinsic spell effects and actual separately obtained equipment keep their stated scopes; this boundary does not cancel Soulburn's settled intrinsic output through a genuinely acquired Grand Reservoir use. Lawful creature consent and knowledge are actual operands, not made true by a spell-selection UI. Unknown or missing native profiles remain particular content prerequisites and not invented templates. There is no sixth DE4 output channel, new setting plane, afterlife or Heartcell interpretation.

# Simulacrum — NEW RIC5-SI-01 through RIC5-SI-06

Action;one actual perceived existing creature and a separately chosen legal arrival within120feet of caster;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP. Both native placements are one identity. Use the actual access school: Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard Illusion; Cleric/Mage Universal. There is no CR, size, living-only, class-level or creature-type ceiling added. A currently willing donor accepts; NEW an unwilling donor makes CHA against the actual caster's DC. Success prevents creation without refund or a profile/secret diagnostic. A hidden missing actual profile never becomes an invented bestiary. Self-copy is allowed. An actual copy-descended donor is ineligible, including this spell's prior duplicates, even when renamed, disguised, repaired or recast; mundane ancestry is not 'copy-descended'.

## Snapshot and creation
At actual resolution, after caster payment, interruptions and donor resistance, revalidate the same donor, its complete operative profile and the chosen whole-body arrival with perception, line of effect, support and no interior overlap. No substitute donor, remote unknown square or free push aside is allowed. The new body is independent physical presence, not a Mirror Image; private provenance records its original creator and donor identity without claiming a soul, afterlife or original civil/quest identity. For a self-copy the donor snapshot is AFTER this cast's RP/use/history/concentration consequences; it does not snapshot a prepayment version.

Copy actual size, anatomy, body mass, native movement, intrinsic ability scores, PB, legitimate proficiencies, senses, damage/condition defenses, innate/native/class actions, explicit attack/save DC operands, prepared/known/book-access content and currently accessible memories. Copy current normal HP and actual maximum, existing Wounds/Critical/injuries and physical losses, not an arbitrary half or automatic maximum. Derive AC from actual intrinsic body and functional replica equipment, excluding external temporary buffs. Do not copy another source's current temporary HP, concentration, live beneficial/harmful magical applications, bestowed permissions, owned summoned creatures, pending attacks/Ready holds, reserved transactions or active control over other bodies. Physical scars/injury persist even when a magical condition record does not. An actual active form's anatomy/profile may be copied, but its remaining source-granted maximum/end restrictions remain attached to this derivative; at that hard form endpoint the duplicate ends rather than obtaining an unprovided alternate body or fresh form use. This specific template choice is disclosed, not an unrestricted permanent-form exploit.

An independently acquired actual creator bonus to summoned-creature maximum HP applies only if its real source includes this creation; the duplicate starts no higher than its snapshotted current HP even when that bonus raises maximum. The worked Illusion/Universal creators have no acquired Conjuration creation bonus. Missing source formulas, statistics or required consumable credentials prevent that particular unsupported ability from being executed; do not pretend that a title or printed CR supplies them. A complete supported donor's ordinary attacks and spells remain real abilities, not harmless images.

## Bounded resources and copy functions
NEW create one persistent derivative resource account keyed by original creator plus actual original donor identity, not by ephemeral body ID. At first creation snapshot the donor's CURRENT unreserved RP/charges/ammunition/uses, Dissonance, last-spell/Refrain, positive recharge counters, prepared-family-used history and other finite expenditures after all preceding commitments. Bound assets, permits, unique quest/boss/artifact entitlements and another person's inventories do not clone. Explicit expiry/debt/one-time-use receipts retain their original ownership context and cannot be spent twice by being copied. Pools are independent from the original donor: spending the duplicate's ordinary RP does not drain the original, but a recast does not create a fresh derivative balance.

When the same creator later recreates the same donor, use the existing derivative account. Any current donor shortfall or new consumed/invalid entitlement can further reduce availability; recast never restores the derivative above its existing available amounts, clears its Dissonance/Refrain, resets a cooldown/use/history, or clones pending reservations. Keep the derivative account’s existing chronological last-spell/Refrain exactly; do not overwrite it with a new donor snapshot. Union actual spent one-use/prepared-family records, take the larger same-unit active Dissonance debt/positive cooldown, and clamp availability to the lower of the derivative balance and donor’s current unreserved amount. The new body’s real source maximum can change with an actually changed donor profile, but raising that maximum grants no current units; a lower maximum clamps availability. A changed profile cannot convert a pool into a different unit. The durable derivative actor-lineage ID owns its casting, hard-control, resource, recovery and source-END/Long-Rest histories; each recreated physical body has a separate body-instance ID. A new body ID never clears that actor-lineage history or provides a second source clock. This is operational identity, not a soul or original-donor identity claim. Real source-required time and costs, not new IDs, govern recovery. While an active body exists it can perform an actually legal source-qualified rest/recovery under real elapsed time, safety, food/water and limited-rest budgets; no foreign blanket 'cannot recover spell slots' rule is imported. An absent/ended derivative account performs no rest, work or recovery. Absolute deadlines continue. Re-creation snapshots current body HP/injury anew only after a genuinely new17RP cast, but never refills resource accounts for free.

Explicitly disable duplication, spell-replay/storage, further-casting-access grants and their copy descendants as executable functions on this derivative. It cannot cast Simulacrum/Cast Echo/Fate Echo or activate a copied spell-copy/casting-access engine to generate another generation or permission factory. This is a NEW restriction of full duplication; ordinary paid noncopy spells, native attacks, defensive/passive features and actual bounded intrinsic outcomes remain. A class feature requiring an original unique body/soul/quest/artifact credential is not replicated merely from its visible result. No XP or level/stat progression, independent feat selection, new permanent repertoire acquisition or native source rewrite occurs; it can form new ordinary episodic memories and perform source-qualified mundane tasks with actual tools, knowledge, work and supplies. Its stored accessible belief is private to that creature; copying it does not give the creator a secret-data dump, true answers or access to sealed memories. A lawful order/question may obtain an answer the duplicate genuinely knows and can communicate, not a global truth oracle.

## Gear and economic identity
Create functional nontransferable replica props for ordinary nonunique mundane equipment actually worn/carried at the snapshot, with its actual damage, armor/weapon/focus/tool statistics, finite ammunition and weight/Load. They are dependent spell props, not copies of the original inventory IDs. No money, treasure value, food/fuel, costly/consumed ingredient, unique/charged magic item, password credential, original owner's title or harvestable material is created. Props count for this body's handling and casting focus where the underlying ordinary focus is permitted. Leaving its custody ordinarily makes that prop vanish; transferring it does not mint equipment or refill its finite ammunition account. NEW native projectile exception: replica ammunition or a replica thrown weapon committed to an actually legal native attack remains functional through that attack’s real flight/collision/resolution, then vanishes at completion or cancellation without recoverable material. Debit the real derivative ammunition/item-use account at commitment. Neither cancellation, missed impact, re-creation nor disappearing ammunition refunds it; no independent transferable projectile or extra attack is created. A replica focus/weapon kept in custody remains usable normally. A genuine magic item is not duplicated: abilities requiring its actual original item remain unavailable until a separately authorized real item is supplied. Real borrowed equipment uses its real owner, attunement, charges and carrying constraints, and drops locally when the duplicate ends/becomes absent. No original body or original gear is consumed, healed, moved or reowned.

## Agency, actions and creator limits
NEW choose controlled-companion agency, not an autonomous second player character. One live Simulacrum application per original creator across both schools; a new successful body replaces the old only after all new admission/placement checks succeed. A counter, successful donor save or failed placement leaves the old nonconcentration body intact. Dead/absent/pending-return bodies still occupy their live application's cap until actually ended. The creation grants no voluntary birth-round action. Its first new regular START/END/cadence/Reaction-refresh opportunities begin with the original owner’s next future regular cycle; an already-underway creation cycle supplies no birth-phase idle-strain vent, recharge or repeated save. Replacing a body does not repeat a durable lineage checkpoint already processed.

Explicitly extend the accepted owner-attached shared companion framework to this body. On the original creator's actual regular turn, one Bonus Action can issue one understood command to this perceived body within60feet and line of effect for its existing attached phase after that regular turn. The execution uses the original creator's shared one-command and, if damaging/control, one-offensive-asset opportunity for that numbered round. Do not create another ledger per duplicate, change controller stats to creator stats, steal a completed/different-body reservation or refund an owner's paid command. It may move up to actual remaining Speed and perform ONE actual native Action or ONE actual native Bonus Action behavior specified by that command, paying its own real resource/component/strain costs. An Attack Action can contain the donor's actual native attacks; no bonus attacks are invented. It receives no second free Bonus Action or independent full turn. Uncommanded behavior is defensive reposition/Dodge only; no off-screen attack, condition, healing, resource generation or professional work loop is implied. Noncombat work/rest needs a real prospective task order, actual uninterrupted time and real inputs; it uses no accelerated combat catch-up.

A native Reaction requires its real source trigger, its own available Reaction and resource credentials. Its budget refreshes once at the original owner's actual regular START; extra turns do not refresh or create an attached phase. An offensive/control Reaction also requires the owner's still-free shared offensive allowance; it cannot double that allowance or debit the creator's separate personal Reaction. Its attached phase supplies source-specific regular START/END/save/recharge/cadence checkpoints for this body only, including the existing one-point idle Dissonance decay only on a genuine regular phase with no spell or magical class ability; it is not an extra owner turn. No owner phase after actual owner death/absence means no commanded execution or refreshed Reaction. Continue only preexisting absolute/registered save/deadline obligations, without inventing actions, recovery or indefinitely frozen hostile effects; where a specific foreign condition lacks a legal phase-to-virtual adapter its complete source integration is a declared prerequisite, not an extra action permission. This proposal supplies the duplicate's own base six-second save-only virtual continuation for its already-existing END-save effects when no owner sequence exists, anchored at last resolved END/application, deduplicated on return to a real phase, with original deadlines unchanged. This is NEW SI-only timing, not a general companion revision. Actual authority transfer requires its own complete accepted source; the creator tag/stat provenance/account do not change. Creator death does not by itself erase the body or grant another controller free ownership.

## Lifetime, healing and endings
NEW instantaneous creation establishes a persistent nonconcentration magical creature/application until actual ending, with no arbitrary finite duration. The same current body can receive actual eligible healing, stabilization/repair and HP prohibitions using its copied active type and real source predicates; no free universal construct repair, resurrection or lost-limb cure is supplied. NEW zero-HP template boundary: an actually dead donor is not an existing creature. A living zero-HP donor is not mislabelled dead, but its snapshotted zero-HP duplicate immediately ends at the creation boundary under this spell’s finite-body lifecycle; it provides no live replacement of an existing Simulacrum, no corpse fuel, healing or inherited Null exception. The paid attempt is not refunded, and the original donor’s Dying/Stable/counters remain unchanged. This local creation-lifecycle choice is not a universal ban on targeting zero-HP creatures. At zero normal HP from subsequent ordinary damage it ends as this finite created body, with no loot/corpse fuel; it is not the donor's death. Explicitly extend the source-qualified finite-body Null rule only here: a genuinely Null-owned zeroing damage root causes NullDisabled instead of this damage-ending event, keeps the same body/account/cap, and permits only independently legal restoration. Independent expiry of a copied-form deadline, dismissal, replacement or actual dispel can still end a NullDisabled duplicate.

Full creating-application suppression saves the SAME body pose/HP/resources/history and makes it absent, with real gear deposited locally; it does not refill HP or end-and-resummon. All world/source deadlines keep advancing. On suppression ending return only at that actual saved pose when the complete body can fit with lawful support; otherwise stay pending until a real local fit or another actual ending. No push, remote relocation, fresh body, auto gear pickup or replayed missed orders. Narrow suppression affects only its actual component/provider, not an automatic full disappearance. A live rank7 application can be ended by an actual qualifying dispel; original donor, real world possessions and prior intrinsic spell consequences are unaffected except where their own source dependencies require cleanup. Original creator may dismiss with an actual Action while perceiving the body/application within120feet; otherwise use actual removal, not an unprinted free global command. At ending dependent props vanish and real items remain locally; preserve the spent derivative account for recast. No afterlife, soul transfer, actual-original resurrection or replacement of the donor's identity is asserted.

Fate Echo remains limited by its independently accepted nondamaging complete-mode gate; this damaging-capable derivative does not acquire Fate eligibility through this paragraph. Cast Echo may create it only through the new paid child route and this spell’s actual full lineage/body/resource rules. An original real Wizard’s settled Soulburn/Grand Reservoir combination is unchanged; a derivative does not evade the explicitly excluded copying/casting-access functions by calling Grand Reservoir an intrinsic recovery grant.

completeSharedRules.wording: Targets and placed bodies retain actual whole-body geometry, supports, plane/environment, custody, weight and Load. Ability-check counter/examination uses the actual task degrees/natural shifts followed by its specified binary collapse. Fresh payload RNG is not a donor's stored roll or a new Fate presentation. Damage follows the source's real save/type defenses, flat-reduction rules, buffers, normal HP, Wounds, life and concentration processing. Damage roots retain the actual dealer and source-specific creation-time Null state; Cast Echo creates a new child, not the donor's root. A finite creature's explicit NullDisabled exception cannot be generalized to living targets or different summons. Zero HP is not automatically actual death. Keep support/Falling and existing injuries, Wounds and independent conditions through invisibility, masking, suspension and copying. A paid effect does not repair unknown content or invent a monster CR or opposed-check modifier.

completeSharedRules.title: Clock, suppression and removal
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual registered regular/virtual markers and absolute deadlines; extra turns do not refresh round allowances or regular-start recharge, and no overdue event is replayed by initiative changes. Incapacitated ends applicable concentration. Suppression is expression-specific and normally does not stop source clocks; dispel/removal is not the same event. Greater Dispel and Lesser Antimagic use their complete actual accepted ranks, areas, paths, timing and persistence, not a generic delete-all rule. The four specifically authored persistent applications below state their own local behavior: Meta Surge stops new waivers while suppressed; Erase removes only the affected protection/memory expression temporarily; Sequester's suspension suppression wakes permanently; Simulacrum full suppression preserves one absent body rather than recreating it. This does not rewrite the differing Companion05 or Illusion13 lifecycles. Existing completed damage/healing/work/memory edits are not rolled back. Due expiry is processed before a new simultaneous voluntary commitment. Source-owned tokens and consumed histories survive resumption, recast and serialization.

completeSharedRules.title: No hidden fact, identity or resource substitution
completeSharedRules.wording: A source's private event, memory or profile record is not a public oracle. No player/controller receives hidden names, HP, allegiance, memories, source IDs or failure-reason diagnostics merely from a paid attempt. A copied memory is no truer than the original accessible belief, and a copied body is not the original entity, its owner, soul, citizen identity or credential. Source-created replica props and derivative bodies supply no loot, XP, corpse fuel, crafting material, soul, resource-on-kill or duplicated historical entitlement. Their expressly paid intrinsic spell effects and actual separately obtained equipment keep their stated scopes; this boundary does not cancel Soulburn's settled intrinsic output through a genuinely acquired Grand Reservoir use. Lawful creature consent and knowledge are actual operands, not made true by a spell-selection UI. Unknown or missing native profiles remain particular content prerequisites and not invented templates. There is no sixth DE4 output channel, new setting plane, afterlife or Heartcell interpretation.

# Erase from Reality — NEW RIC5-ER-01 through RIC5-ER-04

Action;one actual perceived creature within120feet;V/S/F;rank7;base17RP;nonconcentration. A currently willing recipient may accept without resistance. NEW an unwilling recipient makes one CHA save against the actual caster's spell DC; success negates both components, failure admits them subject to their actual separate defenses. There is no creature-type/CR gate by name, no damage and no universal 'mind-affecting' immunity. This does not take the recipient's Actions, so mere untargetability does not spend the whole-Action denial guard.

## Untargetable is not absent or invulnerable
While operative the body cannot be newly selected as an individual direct creature target of an attack, spell, feature or item use, whether harmful, beneficial, self-targeted or targeted by an ally. An unresolved direct effect that explicitly revalidates a creature target at resolution fails against it under that effect's actual paid-target lifecycle; no refund or replacement target is supplied. An already launched physical object/projectile governed by collision is not erased or deflected by this clause: its actual world/collision source must supply its later consequences. No generic projectile engine is claimed. Previously established attached conditions, damage-over-time, controls, restraints, concentration dependencies and effects which operate without selecting a new target continue under their own sources. Actual areas, environmental collisions, support, Falling and mundane custody still affect the real body. You may target a legal point/area without selecting this creature; that area's later snapshot includes the body when its own predicates qualify.

The recipient remains in its real place with real gear, visible/audible when ordinary senses permit, and can act/move/attack other legal targets using real budgets. It is not Invisible, Incapacitated, immaterial, removed from a plane or immune to damage. It cannot use a new self-buff requiring direct self selection during the protection; ordinary existing personal passive state is not a fresh targeting action. An established grapple retains its source and actual reach; Erase does not teleport either body or free the grapple. A deliberate new direct grapple attempt is blocked. Mechanical owner/source IDs remain valid private bookkeeping, not controller targeting permission.

## Temporary memory fading — bounded selected meaning
NEW at establishment snapshot other actual minds within120feet of the recipient with real line of effect and actual perception of that recipient at that moment. The recipient's own mind is excluded. Only these observers receive a source-owned reversible mask on their preexisting episodic/recognition links identifying that recipient: their remembered name, prior recognition and target-associated recollection cannot be used as presently recalled knowledge while the mask is operative. No observer is informed that a spell selected them or given hidden roster/identity metadata. It does not erase language, skills, general facts, loyalties or other people's memories globally; it does not authenticate a disguised recipient. Opaque barriers/out-of-range/unperceiving observers are not included and later entrants are not enrolled.

This is a mask, not deleted history. Diaries, ownership, friendship/faction records, consents, issued orders, cast receipts, hard-control history, resource debts and true world facts remain. A temporarily unavailable remembered justification does not undo an already-lawful transaction or refund it. New sensory observation and new learning remain possible: an observer can see an unfamiliar body now and remember that new event, but cannot recover masked old recognition through private engine entity IDs. Actual memory-interference immunity/prevention can defeat this component for that observer without granting direct targetability through the recipient's independent protection. This selected scope is an explicit completion of 'memory fades temporarily', not global amnesia or a sixth information presentation.

## One source lifetime and ending
NEW both components have the same source deadline: the caster's next future regular START, excluding a START already underway when applied; outside initiative use application+6seconds and preserve the registered clock through initiative changes. Extra turns add no endpoint. Successful same-caster recast on the same recipient replaces only that caster's old source; other sources remain independently keyed and identical protections do not add strength. Each observer retains the mask belonging to each live source; ending one cannot bypass another.

Actual suppression affects only the expressions in its true scope. Suppressing the recipient protection permits otherwise legal new direct targeting while suppressed; a remotely unsuppressed observer mask need not vanish merely because the body entered a local field. Suppressing an observer's mask makes its preexisting available memories usable there; no interval is replayed on resumption. Expiry, genuine full source removal or recipient's actual death removes this source's protection and masks permanently. Zero HP alone is not actual death. Ending a mask removes only its interference from whatever memories really remain: an independent Disrupt Memory deletion or other real edit made during the interval remains deleted/edited, while new memories stay new. Never restore an old serialized full-mind snapshot over later experience. Gear/collision, elapsed costs, completed damage and other applications are not rolled back. No cosmetics are declared cosmological reality erasure.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual bodies, rolls and consequences
completeSharedRules.wording: Targets and placed bodies retain actual whole-body geometry, supports, plane/environment, custody, weight and Load. No point through opaque total cover supplies perception or line of effect. A teleport, absent body or size alteration needs its actual source permission; visual images do not become creatures. Attacks use actual AC and natural1/20 attack rules. Saves are total versus DC without natural-die task shifts. Ability-check counter/examination uses the actual task degrees/natural shifts followed by its specified binary collapse. Fresh payload RNG is not a donor's stored roll or a new Fate presentation. Damage follows the source's real save/type defenses, flat-reduction rules, buffers, normal HP, Wounds, life and concentration processing. Damage roots retain the actual dealer and source-specific creation-time Null state; Cast Echo creates a new child, not the donor's root. A finite creature's explicit NullDisabled exception cannot be generalized to living targets or different summons. Zero HP is not automatically actual death. Keep support/Falling and existing injuries, Wounds and independent conditions through invisibility, masking, suspension and copying. A paid effect does not repair unknown content or invent a monster CR or opposed-check modifier.

completeSharedRules.title: Clock, suppression and removal
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual registered regular/virtual markers and absolute deadlines; extra turns do not refresh round allowances or regular-start recharge, and no overdue event is replayed by initiative changes. Incapacitated ends applicable concentration. Suppression is expression-specific and normally does not stop source clocks; dispel/removal is not the same event. Greater Dispel and Lesser Antimagic use their complete actual accepted ranks, areas, paths, timing and persistence, not a generic delete-all rule. The four specifically authored persistent applications below state their own local behavior: Meta Surge stops new waivers while suppressed; Erase removes only the affected protection/memory expression temporarily; Sequester's suspension suppression wakes permanently; Simulacrum full suppression preserves one absent body rather than recreating it. This does not rewrite the differing Companion05 or Illusion13 lifecycles. Existing completed damage/healing/work/memory edits are not rolled back. Due expiry is processed before a new simultaneous voluntary commitment. Source-owned tokens and consumed histories survive resumption, recast and serialization.

completeSharedRules.title: No hidden fact, identity or resource substitution
completeSharedRules.wording: A source's private event, memory or profile record is not a public oracle. No player/controller receives hidden names, HP, allegiance, memories, source IDs or failure-reason diagnostics merely from a paid attempt. A copied memory is no truer than the original accessible belief, and a copied body is not the original entity, its owner, soul, citizen identity or credential. Source-created replica props and derivative bodies supply no loot, XP, corpse fuel, crafting material, soul, resource-on-kill or duplicated historical entitlement. Their expressly paid intrinsic spell effects and actual separately obtained equipment keep their stated scopes; this boundary does not cancel Soulburn's settled intrinsic output through a genuinely acquired Grand Reservoir use. Lawful creature consent and knowledge are actual operands, not made true by a spell-selection UI. Unknown or missing native profiles remain particular content prerequisites and not invented templates. There is no sixth DE4 output channel, new setting plane, afterlife or Heartcell interpretation.
